Initial release of quality-test-implementation skill.

- Enables comprehensive code quality improvements and test coverage boosts for .NET, Java, and Python repositories.
- Guides static-analysis warning resolution (Roslyn/Sonar, SpotBugs/Checkstyle, Bandit/Ruff), security CVE remediation, and applies key SOLID/DDD/Clean Architecture principles.
- Handles whole-repo interventions rather than single-file or single-change reviews.
- Produces detailed reports and documentation updates (README, CHANGELOG) without auto-opening Pull Requests.
- Sets clear quality standards and checklists for successful interventions.
